newsitem.title: USA: GoodMark says '97 earnings to lag 1996's.
newsitem.headline: GoodMark says '97 earnings to lag 1996's.

text.p: GoodMark Foods Inc said Monday that, given its third quarter experience, in which sales lagged the same-period last year, it believed its earnings in fiscal 1997 would be "well below" 1996's $0.83 a share.

GoodMark Foods also announced it approved the divestiture of its Jesse Jones packaged meats business. The decision, said the company, was based on resource reallocation and the strategic goal of focusing capital investment and human resources on the company's core snack food businesses. Hill Thompson Capital Markets Inc has been retained to find a buyer for the packaged meats business.
The company said the financial impact of the decision cannot be determined at this time.

In addition, the Board of Directors has authorized the repurchase of up to 500,000 shares of the Company's common stock from time to time in open market transactions during the 1997 and 1998 fiscal years. The Company currently has approximately 7.9 million shares outstanding.
